_note: One entry per narration take. say = what the voice reads (spelled for speech); show = the subtitle.

segments.say: On its own, an AI model only produces text. It can't open a file, or run a program.
segments.show: On its own, an AI model only produces text. It can't open a file, or run a program.

segments.say: And software like Origin is built for people: menus, dialogs, buttons. Clicking through a screen is slow, and easy to break.
segments.show: And software like Origin is built for people: menus, dialogs, buttons. Clicking through a screen is slow, and easy to break.

segments.say: But the window is only the top layer. Below it are scripting interfaces, commands, and the core engine. Code can call these directly, but every program does it differently.
segments.show: But the window is only the top layer. Below it are scripting interfaces, commands, and the core engine. Code can call these directly, but every program does it differently.

segments.say: M-C-P, the Model Context Protocol, is a standard way to package those interfaces as tools an AI can read and call.
segments.show: MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is a standard way to package those interfaces as tools an AI can read and call.

segments.say: So what actually happens when you ask an AI to find a paper and save it to Zotero?
segments.show: So what actually happens when you ask an AI to find a paper and save it to Zotero?

segments.say: First, the app you're talking to asks its M-C-P servers what tools they offer. A server is a small program that sits in front of a piece of software.
segments.show: First, the app you're talking to asks its MCP servers what tools they offer. A server is a small program that sits in front of a piece of software.

segments.say: The answer is just text: each tool's name, what it does, and what inputs it needs.
segments.show: The answer is just text: each tool's name, what it does, and what inputs it needs.

segments.say: That text goes to the model, along with your request.
segments.show: That text goes to the model, along with your request.

segments.say: Here's the key point. The model still can't touch any of this software. All it can do is write text.
segments.show: Here's the key point. The model still can't touch any of this software. All it can do is write text.

segments.say: So it writes a request: use this tool, with these inputs.
segments.show: So it writes a request: use this tool, with these inputs.

segments.say: The app passes that to the right server, in a standard message called tools slash call.
segments.show: The app passes that to the right server, in a standard message called tools/call.

segments.say: The server turns it into the program's own commands, and the program does the work. The result comes back as text.
segments.show: The server turns it into the program's own commands, and the program does the work. The result comes back as text.

segments.say: Now the model can read the results, pick a paper, and copy its D-O-I into the next request.
segments.show: Now the model can read the results, pick a paper, and copy its DOI into the next request.

segments.say: It asks Zotero to save the paper in a collection called Solar. But no such collection exists.
segments.show: It asks Zotero to save the paper in a collection called Solar. But no such collection exists.

segments.say: The error comes back as text too, naming the collections that do exist. So the model fixes its request and tries again.
segments.show: The error comes back as text too, naming the collections that do exist. So the model fixes its request and tries again.

segments.say: Nothing in this loop was specific to papers.
segments.show: Nothing in this loop was specific to papers.

segments.say: Connect a server for Origin or Blender, and the model simply reads a longer list.
segments.show: Connect a server for Origin or Blender, and the model simply reads a longer list.

segments.say: Without a standard, every app writes its own connection to every program. With one, a program needs one server, and every M-C-P app can use it.
segments.show: Without a standard, every app writes its own connection to every program. With one, a program needs one server, and every MCP app can use it.

segments.say: That's M-C-P. List the tools, call one, read the result, and repeat.
segments.show: That's MCP. List the tools, call one, read the result, and repeat.
